newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls back on Komercni worries.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls back on Komercni worries.

text.p: 1400 GMT - The Czech PX50 index closes lower on Monday as Komercni Banka falls three percent.
* Overall, 100 shares rise, 94 fall, 40 unchanged. Turnover, 784 million crowns, volume, 495,912 shares.
Czech shares took another tumble on Monday led by the PX50 index's most heavily capitalised banking share Komercni Banka.

Dealers said the heavy rains and flooding which have affected a third of the Czech Republic were probably to blame for Komercni's fall as analysts begin to estimate the knock-on effect on the bank's bottom line of lower company profits and the threat of large scale bankruptcies in the affected regions.
"Foreign investors are concerned about how the floods will be reflected in bank economic performance," said Karel Necesal of Atlantik Financial Markets.
